claims: Recommended childhood and adult vaccines include DTaP/Tdap (pertussis), MMR (measles, mumps, rubella), HPV, Hepatitis A/B, Polio, and Pneumococcal.
Vaccination against RSV is recommended for older adults aged 60+ to prevent severe respiratory illness.
Yearly influenza vaccines are advised for individuals aged 6 months and older.
Updated 2025-26 COVID-19 shots are advised for individuals aged 6 months and older.
Vaccines are available at health departments, doctor offices, and pharmacies.
A 2025 analysis found declining childhood vaccination rates in over 77% of U.S. counties.
